'''Dylah Ha'rangir''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a lieutenant of [[Clan Ha'rangir]]. She was killed during the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
